description: TY2026: a SS 1(g) child whose unearned income ($2,000) is under the $2,700 threshold -> net unearned income $0, and the Form 8615 greater-of collapses to the child's regular tax. Wages $6,000 + interest $2,000, dependent std = 6,450 -> TI 1,550 -> Table midpoint 1,562.50 -> 10% -> $156. Parent facts still demanded (never guessed): MFJ TI 100,000, no preferential income; allocable parental tax = 0. Net $156.00.
